conversation.text:
Police: For a fourth-grade elementary school child, silence is truly too heavy, yet he has kept enduring it.
Police: I really wanted to ease his psychological burden, so I asked everyone I could find—the nearby residents, passersby, shop owners...
Police: There is a place... right behind the flower bed.
Police: Standing there, you can see the amusement park through a small gap, and it’s not easy for Minghao to notice.
Police: You stood there watching them every time, didn’t you?
Respondent: In the amusement park, there are some children about the same age as Xiyuan.
Respondent: When we went to the amusement park, the parents of those children often gathered together and whispered.
Respondent: Minghao must have heard it too.
Respondent: Because Xiyuan always calls me mom, it does easily cause misunderstandings.
Respondent: I can understand why Minghao would dislike me, so I didn’t feel too hurt because of it.
Respondent: It was probably a few weeks ago. Minghao told me not to go near them and to stay away. Then, while I was wandering around nearby, I discovered that place.
Respondent: Minghao...
Respondent: He must really hate that I did this... but...
Respondent: I...
Respondent: Although I am not his mother, but...
Respondent: I promised Yuanying that I would protect them well.
Respondent: I never expected it to turn out like this in the end.
Respondent: It really was only for a short while...
Respondent: Because standing on tiptoe all the time was too exhausting, I just rested for a short while...
